scope: 100 research candidates; not 100 runnable tasks or demonstrated Terra failures. Security tasks excluded. Hardness must come from one compact crux, not long workflows or imposed reasoning scarcity.

evidence_levels.T: Previously audited external Terra zero-reward reference; existing fairness caveats remain.
evidence_levels.C: New external Terra completed partial-credit CAD observation with score details; independent geometry audit pending.
evidence_levels.H: Harbor-Index task-level publisher TP/TN/FP/FN labels; individual completion audit pending, no Terra row.
evidence_levels.B: Public task specification/metadata or source fixture inspected; no qualifying Terra failure established.
evidence_levels.I: Exact parent ID found in a benchmark index; proposed extraction needs full statement/data audit.
evidence_levels.P: Community or primary-specification hypothesis; not measured model difficulty.
